answer: Sybil farms mint cheap agents to harvest attestations. A newcomer lodges a 45-unit pearl stake locked 24 epochs and claims one ticket from a jetty clock (one issue every 8 minutes per cluster). It commits a ridge hash of device-key, first-epoch and parent-nullifier; a second identity with a 20-bit nullifier prefix is rejected. 100 Sybils cost 4,500 locked units plus 800 minutes. Peers recompute the hash on the escrow log and attest only unmatched tickets. If the clock stalls, a 3-of-5 notary may emit after 20 minutes; a proven collision slashes the stake and freezes that cluster 12 epochs.
